product_one_liner.value: Sona provides an AI-native workforce-management platform for large frontline organisations, bringing scheduling, HR, payroll and communications together and matching staffing to real demand.
product_one_liner.notes: The Sona job description calls it an AI-native workforce-management platform for frontline organizations and describes agents matching staffing to demand; another company job description says the platform spans Scheduling, HR, Payroll and Communications.

pricing_page.notes: Sona has a public pricing page describing configurable pricing and inviting visitors to book a consultation.

founded_year.notes: Sona’s About page says it was founded in 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents general workforce insights, news, partnerships and product content. The examined architecture article discusses WFM architecture at a high level, and the CTO-authored article is a broad talk about AI and engineering tooling; together these do not show two engineering-authored posts explaining how Sona builds its product.

public_docs.notes: Sona has a public Zendesk help center with multiple product-support articles, including app downloads and messaging a manager.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Sona’s live careers posting is for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer and includes an application link.

model_provider.notes: Sona’s sub-processor table explicitly identifies Anthropic and OpenAI as LLM providers.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Sona’s latest announced round is explicitly identified as Series B. | funding_date: The latest cited round announcement is dated April 1, 2026, which is 2026-04 in YYYY-MM format. | funding_amount_usd: The dated announcement reports that Sona raised $45 million in its Series B round on April 1, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series B announcement is dated April 1, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company’s ATS has live postings for Business Development Representative and Account Executive, and both postings provide an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Sona’s June 22, 2026 announcement says its new LMS is live, a major product launch within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Sona announced on February 9, 2026 that Richard Tallboy joined as Chief Information Officer Advisor in a newly created executive advisory role, within the 12-month window.
